body:
Closed the real ceiling against the 'GTA3-style open city' pitch: players were hard-locked to one worldapi chunk (cx=0,cz=0) since Phase 0. Founder: "continue" -- picked as the next appropriately-sized real increment following this session's own Phase 0/1 sequencing discipline.

packages/common/papercraft_world.h grew PwWorld -- a fixed, non-streaming 3x3 grid (PW_GRID_RADIUS=1, 9 chunks) loaded once at startup around spawn -- plus pw_world_ground_height_at, which resolves a real world-space (x,z) to the right chunk (floor-division-correct for negative coords) before delegating to the existing per-chunk lookup. Dynamic load/unload as the player roams stays real, later work -- this proves the fetch/store/lookup/render plumbing first.

apps/server/src/main.c: fetch_city_world replaces fetch_city_chunk (9 real HTTP calls, same fail-closed discipline); movement collision gate now resolves ground height against the whole real grid. apps/client/src/main.c: same 9-chunk fetch; draw_city_world replaces draw_city_chunk, offsetting each chunk's blocks by its own real chunk origin so the grid tiles correctly in world space.

Real, honest infrastructure finding (not a Papercraft bug): diffed GET /chunks?scene=200&cx=0&cz=0 against cx=1&cz=0 live -- zero-line difference. GFD's own worldapi urban-chunk generator doesn't vary content by (cx,cz) yet, so the grid renders as a repeating tile today. Real content variety is GFD's own future work.

Verified live with a real UDP probe: walked a player continuously from spawn (x=8) through the old single-chunk boundary at x=16 out to x=30 (real neighbor chunk cx=1) -- server-reported y stayed a correctly-resolved 65.00 the entire way (old code would have frozen y the instant x left [0,16)). Client launched under Xvfb, confirmed draw_city_world renders all 9 chunks with no crash/regression (real player marker + stat HUD still correct).

bazel build //... and bazel test //... both clean (12 targets, 5/5 mod tests passing, no BUILD.bazel changes needed).

NORTHSTAR.md updated to document this as shipped and verified.

Commits: 4e77fbd (feat), 5f6b513 (changelog).

⚓ ☃
title: Real multi-chunk city traversal shipped -- a fixed 3x3 grid, verified end-to-end
